summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing an adjustment to the conversion rate of its 2031 convertible senior notes due to a regular cash dividend. The conversion rate increased from 9.8915 to 9.9823 ADS per $1,000 principal, effective June 11, 2026, reflecting standard anti-dilution provisions. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. This is a routine contractual adjustment with no premium, board recommendation, or deal mechanics.
